prompt: Sign Terry Rozier to Miami on a one-year minimum contract, then trade him to Boston for Derrick White.

verdict.summary: Trade is invalid. Miami Heat do not satisfy salary matching requirements.

violations: Hard cap violation: This trade would push Miami Heat over the second apron hard cap ($221.7M)

allowances: Sign-and-trade (§8(e)(1)): Boston Celtics are over the cap, but this trade drops their salary to $179.6M, below the first apron ($209.0M) — S&T acquisition permitted
Expanded TPE: Sending $30.3M, can receive up to $32.7M (first apron hard cap applies: $209.0M), matching $3.3M
Note: Boston Celtics are a luxury tax team — limited to Taxpayer MLE ($6.1M) for future signings

appliedRules: NBA CBA 2023 (2026-27 season) — Art. VII §6(j) Traded Player Exception

§8(e)(1): Over-cap S&T receiver — permitted only when the trade itself brings the team below the first apron
